about: Size, power and interval coverage of candidate test procedures for the confirmatory contrasts (PLAN.md section 6), by simulation at the episode structure of the E3 eligible list and of the scoreable dev statements. Train-period data only.

procedures.percentile: registered percentile bootstrap p-value and interval (PLAN section 6)
procedures.bca: bias-corrected and accelerated bootstrap, p-value by inverting the interval
procedures.studentised: bootstrap-t on the cluster-robust standard error, equal-tailed
procedures.studentised_symmetric: bootstrap-t, symmetric two-sided p-value and interval
procedures.sign_flip: cluster sign-flip test on episode sums; interval of half-sample means
procedures.sign_flip_t: cluster sign-flip test on the studentised mean (wild cluster bootstrap-t)
procedures.t_cr1: cluster-robust t, G / (G - 1) correction, G - 1 degrees of freedom
procedures.t_cr2: bias-reduced cluster-robust t, Satterthwaite degrees of freedom (independence)
procedures.t_cr2_icc: bias-reduced cluster-robust t, Satterthwaite at the estimated correlation
procedures.t_cr3: leave-one-episode-out cluster-robust t, G - 1 degrees of freedom
procedures.max_t: larger of the bootstrap-t and studentised sign-flip p-values, each side

generators.empirical: whole dev episodes of similar size rank; a donor is gone round
generators.empirical_chained: whole dev episodes of similar size rank; donors are chained
generators.empirical_any_size: whole dev episodes of any size, gone round (stress case)
generators.empirical_sizes_drawn: as empirical, with the episode sizes drawn as well (a ratio)
generators.empirical_sparse: as empirical, all differences zero but in a random 15% of the episodes
generators.copula: latent random effects, dev marginal, dev within-episode correlation
generators.copula_heavy: as copula, episode effect from a t distribution with 3 degrees of freedom
generators.copula_extremes: as copula, 2% of the mass at the bound on the side of the longer tail
